## Body

PR 305 at 52ffd6c146b8515fff631ec1fd6c8b49ec408894: pass-with-notes, no correctness blocker. F253 closes the known unescaped card colour/PR and external-font paths. Nine dependency-free contract groups and nine independent mutations pass; exact-head Node 22/24 CI each has fleet-map 18/18.

Generator and page both retain positive safe-integer PR numbers and 3/6-digit hex colours. Lookup uses the same PR validator as serialization; a valid child remains discoverable under an invalid parent. Keep a real argv receipt rather than relying solely on a warning-string absence.

Inherited exception: assignColours treats falsy colour fields as missing, fills/persists them before validation, and emits no invalid-colour warning. Nonempty invalid colours are warned/fallback-only without rewriting.

Character-count layout is not font-metric independence. With the new system stack, actual Chrome box checks show tiny role-pill overruns: fixture pm-100 about 1.9 px, current-structure pm-001 about 0.9 px. Measure the text bbox against its actual remaining pill bounds, not an assumed uniform padding. Geometry constants/layout code are unchanged.

Chrome rendered fixture, hostile raw-data and copied current-structure standalone pages with no resource entries/page errors. Six hostile card paths stayed inert. No source/live-output writes, dependency installation or linking; local harness quick gate remains dependency-limited under C25.

magicWand: encode the browser text-containment and dependency-free mutation probes as a supported review recipe. Session artifacts and the governed verdict preserve the proof design and its nonblocking font/defaulting notes.
